ClearChange.description: Marks the field unknown (`status=missing`). Never sets zero.
ClearChange.title: ClearChange

ConfirmProfileFieldsRequest.description:
`confirm_profile_fields` (G3): the employee confirms that stored *actual* values are
still correct. Values never change; only confirmation metadata and revisions do. Separate
from `update_conversation_inputs` (an unchanged `set` is never a confirmation).
ConfirmProfileFieldsRequest.title: ConfirmProfileFieldsRequest

CurrentArrangementView.description: Last-reported current arrangement; each element carries its own status.
CurrentArrangementView.title: CurrentArrangementView

EntitlementGroup.description: Source Hebrew group labels are preserved as values.
EntitlementGroup.title: EntitlementGroup

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable failure codes. Never shown raw to employees.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

FieldPath.description: Allowlisted fields of the actual EmployeeProfile / case working state.
FieldPath.title: FieldPath

Issue.description: A business-level observation. Never contains raw exceptions or salary documents.
Issue.title: Issue

RepresentativeFieldCode.description: Server-recognized facts a representative may supply (provisional allowlist).
RepresentativeFieldCode.title: RepresentativeFieldCode

ResolveOccupationRequest.description: `resolve_occupation` (G2). Without a query, every official occupation is returned.
ResolveOccupationRequest.title: ResolveOccupationRequest

ResolveOccupationResult.description:
`resolved` only for an official ID or an exact normalized official name; otherwise
candidates for clarification (`ambiguous`) or `not_found`. Never a guessed or new ID.
ResolveOccupationResult.title: ResolveOccupationResult

SourceType.description: Provenance of a value. `document_confirmed` is future-only and deliberately absent.
SourceType.title: SourceType

VehicleRef.description: Exactly one of a catalogue identifier or a complete official tax key.
VehicleRef.title: VehicleRef

VehicleTaxKey.description:
Official five-part key: (שנת מס, שנת רישום, קוד סוג רכב, קוד תוצר, קוד דגם).

Codes are strings and keep leading zeros exactly as in the source dataset.
VehicleTaxKey.title: VehicleTaxKey
